name: Grilled snakehead
summary: Cá lóc nướng is on Vietnam Tourism’s Can Tho food list. A one-day article on the department site says cá lóc nướng trui is served at Mỹ Khánh. A cooking method was not printed on the opened national list. Check on arrival for the table style.
origin: Can Tho on the national list, and Mỹ Khánh on the department article.
howToEat: A main meal. The national page does not say how the fish is eaten.
where: Can Tho, and the garden tables at Mỹ Khánh.
seoDescription: Cá lóc nướng on Vietnam Tourism’s Can Tho list, and cá lóc nướng trui at Mỹ Khánh on a department article.
